unlisted_practices: Future AI-enabled trials should place greater emphasis on understanding the conditions that allow technological advances to translate into meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.

Future studies should incorporate more granular measures of alert burden and formally evaluate its role, together with clinician engagement, in shaping real-world effectiveness of AI-enabled screening.

screen.reason: This is a correspondence/letter discussing the impact of clinician engagement, alert burden, and workflow integration on AI deployment rather than presenting a standalone empirical study.
